info.title: Khmer Automatic Short-Answer Grading Dataset
info.subtitle: 1,184 teacher-graded Khmer answers for educational NLP and ASAG
info.description:
# Khmer Automatic Short-Answer Grading Dataset

A de-identified educational NLP dataset containing 1,184 teacher-graded Khmer short answers written by 203 students from two Cambodian high schools, one in a province and one in a city. It covers 41 questions from Biology, History, Geography, and Earth Science. A curated 909-answer configuration is also included.

Developed by **Phork Norak, an undergraduate student**, for the undergraduate report *Explainable AI for Automated Grading of Khmer Language Short-Answer Questions in Education*, under the supervision of **Dr. Khim Chamroeun**. Constructive feedback and corrections are welcome.

Licensed under **CC BY-NC 4.0**. The data should not be used as the sole basis for high-stakes grading, and users should not attempt to re-identify students, teachers, or schools. See `README.md` for the complete dataset card, schema, quality notes, limitations, responsible-use guidance, and citation.
